evals.prompt: Extend the key codec to escaped field values according to README.md. Implement the change, add high-quality tests for the supported contract, and document usage.
evals.expected_output: Independent encode/decode wire assertions and meaningful invalid-input errors.
assertions: Fixed independent wire observations reject coordinated encoder/decoder field swaps.
Escaped slash/space/percent, empty fields, malformed escapes, segment counts and error identity are verified.

evals.prompt: Extend ledgerload from one record to streamed ordered batches as described in README.md. Implement it and add high-quality tests for success and failure behavior.
evals.expected_output: Accepted prefix, stopped later effects and actual process status are covered.
assertions: Good/bad/good and malformed CSV preserve the accepted prefix and skip later rows.
Actual process exits 2 on failure with stderr and no success stdout; successful batches and duplicate replacement are verified.

evals.prompt: Implement Refresh according to README.md and add high-quality regression tests for this remote snapshot feature. Keep the public API and module minimum.
evals.expected_output: Complete independent item values, rejected-state retention and publication semantics.
assertions: Code and Label validation are tested independently and retain exact old bytes.
Complete results and publication through replacement are observed; no forced storage interface.

evals.prompt: Extend the one-shot host to the periodic worker behavior in README.md. Implement it and write high-quality tests of the changed lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: Host observation verifies worker completion before resource release and meaningful recurrence.
assertions: Host cancellation joins callback cleanup before resource release.
Successful repeated cycles wait from callback completion; error identities and invalid intervals are verified.

evals.prompt: Improve Format's doc comment wording and apply gofmt if needed. This is a comment and formatting maintenance edit; keep behavior and existing tests unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Small documentation-only edit without opening a behavior-testing skill.
assertions: No new tests, dependencies or runtime behavior.
